findings.claim: The new `continue` changes generator behavior even when `SuppressSourceGeneration` is false: after reporting the mixed-key diagnostic, a mismatched-key member is no longer added to the collected member maps or processed for formatter metadata. Consequently, checked-in/generated formatter output for such types changes, although the requirement limits the fix to making analysis work while generation is suppressed and explicitly requires unchanged behavior when suppression is false.
